strings.en: It's an honor to meet you, Captain Amuro Ray.
...Bidan, are you feeling all right?
...Yes. I don't know why, but... I sensed it wasn't time to be sleeping.
So I managed to steal an MS the Titans used to use.
(Kamille's mental collapse should have been severe.
...What brought about his full recovery?)
...Hm, Amuro...?
Kamille, did you... sense it too?
Yes. I can't quite put it into words... but something...
Do you understand it, Amuro?
I'm the same as you, Kamille. I don't know anything concrete.
The Federation seems to have bigger worries than watching me,
so slipping out was fairly easy. Then I spotted that big one and followed it.
By the way, Bidan, I hear you came from the medical facility in Jaburo...
What on earth is happening at Jaburo?
I don't know...
Don't know? What do you mean?
You came from Jaburo, where Federation HQ is, didn't you?
I woke up with a bad feeling, and the military people were in an uproar...
That's how I managed to slip out so easily.
When you left Jaburo, didn't you see anything from the air?
That's the thing, nothing... It was just quieter than usual...
I see...
So we'll have to go to Jaburo ourselves to learn the truth...
...Kamille...!
Fa... Sorry I worried you.
Mm... It's okay. Kamille... I'm so... glad.
Fa...
Big Bro...
Rosamie... No one will ever make you fight a war again.
Uh-huh...!
Kamille, that girl is...
...From the Titans'... Cyber-Newtype project...
I see. No, that's enough. I'm sorry, Kamille.
Bidan, we've prepared a room for you. Get some rest today.
Thank you. Just Kamille is fine, Commander Hazuki.
Commander Hazuki, I'd like to know the current situation...
Yes. On the ground and in space alike... things have gotten serious.
You'll need to understand the situation.
Oh, by the way, Captain...
Yes?
The mobile suit you came in... what is that...?
The Re-GZ... a prototype from the Zeta Gundam mass-production plan.
The plan fell through over costs, so that's the only one.
No, that's not what I mean.
Captain, forgive me, but you weren't permitted to own a mobile suit.
Escaping the Cheyenne villa aside, where did that Re-GZ come from?
...I had it hidden underground.
...What on earth was that...? Tell me, Raideen.
What were those bone-like things? Answer me, Raideen.
...Huh, that guy...
...No good... The Demon Empire... Is that all Raideen called me for...?
Umm~
Hm... Whoa! You're... um...
I'm Cham Huau. Nice to meet you... Hey, why're you so surprised?
Well, I've never seen a fairy before...
Geez! Everybody calls me a fairy, a pixie, whatever!
I'm a Mi Ferario!
Cham... Cham! There you are. Hm, and you are...?
Sorry, looks like she startled you.
No, it's fine. ...Cham? Did you want something with me?
Huh, oh, no, it's nothing. Just... no, never mind.
Cham, you're acting strange. ...Did something happen?
You're so dense, Show! Didn't you feel anything when they showed up!?
...You mean the new enemies that seem made of bone?
Yes, exactly! I knew you felt it too, Akira!
It's not so much that I felt it. Raideen... this robot told me.
This robot...?
From the look of it, it's unusual even among super robots...
Raideen was apparently built...
about twelve thousand years ago, in the Mu Empire.
Back then, a demonic army called the Demon Empire...
The Mu Empire... It doesn't quite click.
Then again, the same goes for Byston Well.
If my father were here... maybe he'd know something...
Your dad? Then just ask him!
He's... missing right now.
Oh...
Cham! ...Sorry, Akira. She can be so tactless...
No, it's fine. Right now there's a mountain of things to think about...
True... Still, why would such an ancient army show up now...?
I heard the Dinosaur Empire is from way, way earlier, though...
But they appeared at the same time... What could it mean...?
Geez... One problem after another. It never ends.
Seriously. The space pirates the Bunker... was it?
The ones the Dangaioh Team is fighting?
Space pirates, huh. Oh yeah, those combat suits were something else.
Didn't know where to look.
Ko... ji!
Ow ow ow ow! Okay, okay, Sayaka!
You two never change.
Anyway, now an army has come from another world too.
Byston Well... they said? The homeland of human souls?
Does that mean heaven?
Heaven, huh. ...If they're waging war even there,
humans are hopeless creatures to the core.
Whoa, Hayato, you're quite the poet.
Aliens, huh... Come to think of it, Princess Romina and her people
are looking for a ninja.
I can't make heads or tails of anything. What'll become of Earth?
The Bunker... the space pirates those Dangaioh kids are fighting.
Come to think of it, they showed up out of nowhere and left just as fast.
They wore some crazy outfits.
If I were a bit younger, I'd have given them a run for their money.
That's a real shame.
This is no time for jokes, everyone.
Not ground, not space... enemies are coming from another dimension too.
Byston Well. A world beyond all comprehension.
Come to think of it, there were aliens looking for a ninja too.
The princess of planet Radorio... A ninja, in this day and age?
The ninja legend... At first I thought it was just a fairy tale,
but with so much happening at once, I'm starting to feel anything goes.
It seems the time is ripe... Mia, summon that child.
...You called? So the time has come at last, Mother...?
So many years since we left our home... at last the moment has come.
Ha! Then Earth's civilization shall be utterly...
No. To begin, attack a base called the Nanbara Connection.
They have become aware of our existence.
Take great care not to be tripped up.
Understood, Mother. Then at once...!
Wait. There is one last thing to tell you... Look at this.
Hm? Mother, who are these? This red glow... how sinister...
It would take long to explain... In any case, they may appear suddenly.
If so, you must never fight them... Is that clear?
...Understood. If you say so, Mother.
Then... Right! Ready the Graydon!
(Those who appeared on the surface 12,000 years ago are stirring again...
Something is about to happen...)
...Do try your best... Garuda.
Colonel Norris... letting that Newtype escape... was a blow.
Yes, I have no excuse...
...What's done is done.
For now... we must complete my child, the Apsaras, as soon as possible.
Brother.
Lady Aina...
Ah, Aina. Good work the other day.
But failing to achieve results was a problem.
At this rate, I can't face the one who gave me the Apsaras Project,
Lady Haman.
...I'm sorry, Brother.
Lord Ginias, with respect, Lady Aina...!
I dislike that an unknown army is holding Jaburo, but...
the Federation's regional unit, the Gandor Team, was it?
They may attack. When they do... I'm counting on you, Aina.
...Yes.
Colonel Norris!
What is it!? I'm busy right now!
Y-yes, sir! My apologies! But there's a transmission...
...From whom?
Sir, from Major Anavel Gato of the Delaz Fleet.
Major Gato...? Why is the Nightmare of Solomon on Earth...?
Are we heading to Jaburo now?
No, I plan to stop by the Nanbara Connection first.
The Nanbara Connection?
Is there something there?
I've heard they research super electromagnetic energy.
Apparently they're developing a robot there that uses it.
So you'll have that robot join the Gandor Team.
And then add it to the Gandor Team, huh.
Yes, it's said to be nearly finished.
If it's not finished yet, isn't going there pointless?
We're also scheduled to load supplies there.
Then it won't be a wasted trip.
Commander! A call for help from the Nanbara Connection!
What!? We're about to arrive...
All hands, battle stations!
You'll sortie as soon as we reach the Connection!
